metadata.slot_numbering: assignments[0] is the debug slot (slot 0, reuses slot 1's stimuli); real slots are 1..num_participants
metadata.constraint: No two adjacent task trains have the same length.

moment_matching.mean: exactly 50 in the observation and forecasting phases (hence combined)
moment_matching.sd: stationary SD = ar_sd_parameter / sqrt(1 - rho^2) (population SD, divide by n) in each phase, sum of squares within 0.5
moment_matching.rho: OLS slope of x_t on x_{t-1} with intercept, within 0.0005 of nominal in each phase
moment_matching.start_value: first value is a draw from the stationary distribution, rounded; never adjusted
